notes.title: Road Trip to the End of the World OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663872/0a3dabf1a3ebd36ec6acad28ff96eb4f50593768.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Get in, loser, we’re wedding crashing. [/h2][p]
[i]Road Trip to the End of the World[/i] is now available to play! Are you ready to join Andy and Fishy on their cross-country road trip?
[/p][p]This game has been a real labor of love for the past year, and I’m super excited to share it with everyone! I hope this story can open more conversations about friendship breakups, because I sure needed them. If you play the game and find it relatable, I’d love to hear your thoughts <3[/p][p][/p][p][i]- Alex @ Shark and Pelican Games[/i][/p][p][/p][p]------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[/p][h2]ABOUT THE GAME:[/h2][p]Andy Min is having the worst summer: on top of dropping out of med school, she’s been uninvited from her ex-best friend’s wedding. Join her and her imaginary friend Fishy on a cross-country drive to eat burgers, crash a wedding, and perhaps even find closure.
[/p][p]Warning: closure sold separately.[/p]
